UniversalVault is a macOS menu-bar app that stores structured personal records encrypted on this Mac. Control+Option+V opens a search palette over whatever app you are in; search a field, press Return, and the value is typed into the focused field. An item can be marked protected, which seals its fields under a second key and asks for Touch ID before they are read. An item can also be marked for agents, which lets a local command print its non-sensitive fields as JSON. The vault opens at launch without a prompt. Sleep, screen lock, or an inactivity timeout close protected items only; Vault > Lock closes everything. There is no cloud sync.

It is your first ten minutes with it. Describe what you expected before you opened it, what you looked for, what you tried, and what you think the product should have told you at each step. Say where you stopped and why.
